title: Lissity on the union of stratum interiors
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $E$ be an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and let $T$ be a finite locally closed constructible stratification [def-constructible-stratification]. Suppose the set inverse image of the underlying set sheaf of $E$ to every stratum is finite locally constant [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Put $W=\bigcup_i\operatorname{int}_Z(T_i)$. The underlying set sheaf of the abelian inverse image of $E$ to $W$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is finite locally constant.

source.place: ## Proof, first three paragraphs (closedness, reduction, generic lisse source)

proof.text: Transport each given set restriction through etaleInverseImageAlgebraicStructures to the underlying set sheaf of the abelian inverse image. Finite local constancy is invariant under isomorphism: use the same trivializing cover, apply overPullback.mapIso on its members, and apply sheafFiber.mapIso on geometric stalks.

For an interior V_i and the stratum immersion b form P=V_i times_Z T.domain i, with projections p and q. The range of the open immersion a:V_i to Z lies in the range of b since interior(T_i) is contained in T_i. Hence p is surjective by surjective_pullback_fst_of_range_subset. It is an immersion by base change, and IsClosedImmersion.of_isImmersion_of_surjective makes it closed, hence a universal homeomorphism. These geometry helpers are already proved in WeilConjectures.ConstructibleSheaf.Refinement.

Pull back b inverse image E along q with pullback_finite_locally_constant. Rewrite q followed by b as p followed by a and use upperStarComp to obtain finite local constancy of the underlying set sheaf of p inverse image(a inverse image E). Apply finite_local_abelian_forget_iff to obtain abelian local constancy and actual finite abelian stalks. The already proved IsLocallyConstantSheaf.of_upperStar descends local constancy along p. For an algebraically closed geometric point s of V_i, exists_comp_eq_of_surjective lifts s to t of P. upperStarCompSheafFiberIso identifies the finite stalk at t with the stalk at s. Apply finite_local_abelian_forget_iff in the reverse direction. This proves lissity on each interior without assuming factorization through its stratum.

Use Stratification.interiorUnionCover. The equality homOfLE followed by the union inclusion equals the interior inclusion, together with upperStarComp, transports the preceding result to the restriction of G=E restricted to the union on every cover member. Apply finite_local_abelian_forget_iff on each member. IsLocallyConstantSheaf.of_cover from GenericConstancy glues their abelian local constancy after changing the open cover to an etale cover. For each algebraically closed geometric point s of the union, choose a cover member containing its image, lift s using exists_comp_eq_of_mem_range, and transport the finite abelian stalk through upperStarCompSheafFiberIso. Apply finite_local_abelian_forget_iff to G. The interior cover can be empty, and no point or cover member is chosen unless one is given.

proof_origin.place: Proof paragraphs 1--3; C2 formalization follows the same fibre-product and interior-open-cover route, using the existing finite abelian/set comparison and proved abelian local-constancy descent; finite stalks are carried separately and never replaced by finite generation.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_on_stratum_interiors
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (E : Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (T : Stratification Z)
    (hT : ∀ i : Fin T.n, IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((etaleSetPullback (T.immersion i)).obj
        ((sheafCompose Z.smallEtaleTopology
          (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj E))) :
    IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose T.interiorUnion.toScheme.smallEtaleTopology
        (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} T.interiorUnion.ι).obj E))
